description:
Plan, visualize, & document core molecular biology procedures


SnapGene 9.0 introduces a number of new features, including Primer Databases, making it possible to save primers in a single central location, and reuse these across your sequence files. CRISPR Guide Design enables visualization and scoring of CRISPR guide RNAs directly within SnapGene. Search improvements make it easier to find and display results clearly. A number of improvements have also been made across data views, with side-by-side split view and rotating maps giving more flexibility to sequence views.
Primer Databases
Save your primer sequences from your DNA files, or import primers from spreadsheets, to a central primer database within SnapGene. Labels provide an easy way to organize primers into groups, and manage your primer database. These primers can then be used to annotate your other sequence files, giving an easy way to manage your primer sequences across all your files in a single location.

CRISPR Guide Design
Find and visualize CRISPR guide RNAs directly in SnapGene using a variety of PAM sequences, with results displayed in a convenient table. Score designed CRISPR guides for efficiency and specificity using a number of peer-reviewed algorithms on our secure cloud server. Specificity scoring provides a selection of common genomes to score against.

Search Improvements
Search improvements make it easier to perform searches and identify results across your project folders and primer database. Results are organized by the type of search hit, and clearly show where your result was found.

More Control Over Your Data
Enhancements across data views enable more customization of sequence views. Split view functionality has been extended to support both side-by-side and top-and-bottom views, while map view now supports rotating sequences. Multifile selections now offer the ability to view multiple sequences in map view, giving a clear summary of your files. Improvements to multisequence file import make it easier to manage sequence files and convert them into SnapGene format.
